message.content: {"caption":"A schematic of an agent inspecting a conversation transcript, managing memory, and using the resulting profile to answer a follow-up question.","description":"The diagram shows a SelfMem memory workflow. At upper left, a blue panel contains “Memory Principles”: keep memory useful, accurate, cheap, and safe for future conversation, with bullets for Source-backed, Latest-aware, Auditable, Flexible format, and an ellipsis. A shield-and-check icon accompanies the principles. Below, “Memory Action Space” lists Read the transcript, Read current memory, Write or revise memory, Check memory quality, Self-test / improve memory process, and Extend the memory toolkit; small tool and gear icons illustrate the toolkit. An unlabelled arrow points right from this panel toward a blue robot icon labeled “Agent.” Above the agent, a yellow “Transcript store” box states “272 turns,” “136 user / 136 assistant,” and that turns are stored as SQLite with fields turn_index, turn_id, role, time_anchor, content, rendered, and char_count. An unlabelled arrow points down from the store to the agent. A second unlabelled arrow points right from the agent to the large peach “Memory Trajectory” box. Its ten numbered steps are: (1) Inspect transcript, conversation_manifest(): 272 turns; 136 user + 136 assistant. (2) Skim beginning, SQL ASC LIMIT 5: Darryl asks about comfy sneakers. (3) Skim ending, SQL DESC LIMIT 5: Aug 20 / Aug 22 event topics. (4) Count roles, SQL GROUP BY role: confirms paired chat structure. (5) Search candidate facts, SQL LIKE keywords: sneaker, budget, festival, location rows. (6) Inspect memory, memory_read(\"workspace\"): checks current memory state. (7) Write broad profile, memory_change(...): Darryl + preferences + entities + dates. (8) Review quality, memory_review(...): warns stale facts / broad memory. (9) Refine memory, memory_change(...): stable preferences only. (10) Audit source turns, SQL turn_index IN (...): verifies source rows. A yellow looping-arrow icon sits beside the Memory Trajectory heading. An unlabelled downward arrow leads from this box to a blue box titled “SelfMem Memory Generated by Agent,” which lists User: Darryl; stable sneaker preferences of comfort, neutral colors, arch support, breathable materials, and grip; stable people Kyle, Lauren, Maureen, Fred, Bradley, and Christopher; stable locations East Janethaven, Foot Locker, Montserrat, SneakerLab, and Finish Line; and an ellipsis. An unlabelled left-pointing arrow connects this generated-memory box to a second robot labeled “Agent.” At lower left, a pink speech bubble asks, “How many days passed between when I got the size 11 Ultraboost and when I reordered the size 11.5?” Below it, a green speech bubble gives the answer: “One day passed between when I got the size 11 Ultraboost on April 30 and when I reordered the size 11.5 on May 1.” The green bubble points toward the agent and has a green checkmark badge; the pink bubble’s tail points left. The robot icons represent the agent, and the check and tool icons visually accompany memory quality and memory actions.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
